newsitem.title: USA: Arterial sees int'l pricing pressure. [Corrected 23:54 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Arterial sees int'l pricing pressure. [Corrected 23:54 gmt]

text.p: Arterial Vascular Engineering Inc said Monday its earnings may be hurt because an increasing number of stents are available in the international market as companies jockey for market share.

Arterial Vascular said the increased competition has caused pricing pressure which could prompt it to reduce prices on some or all of its products. Revenues and earnings for the coming quarter could be pressured as a result, the company said.
Stents are medical prostheses inserted into arteries after balloon angioplasty to prevent blockages.
The company sells its products in the France, Switzerland, Netherlands, Germany and the United Kingdom. (Deletes reference to U.S.)
